observations.behavior: Adds a Zustand store with persisted state to track whether the PostHog Web feedback intercept has been shown and whether the storage has hydrated.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a shared, persisted state for the PostHog Desktop app to remember if the user has already seen the feedback intercept, preventing it from re-showing after submission or dismissal.

observations.behavior: Imports the new feedback store into the root router layout.
observations.posthog_connection: Connects the feedback state to the application's routing and feedback handling, allowing the router to access the persisted state and hydration status.

observations.behavior: Retrieves the persisted seen status and hydration status, and the mark function, then uses them to conditionally skip the feedback modal and open the PostHog Web URL.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the app to distinguish between a successful storage read and a failed read, ensuring the feedback intercept is not shown if the storage read fails, while still allowing the user to proceed.
